verdict.rationale: The GitHub repo documents a prebuilt container image of the open-source branch on GHCR, bundling headless Chrome, LibreOffice and CJK fonts, so Reader runs without building it. Self-host configuration such as an S3-compatible page cache is also described, though the rotating proxy pool is routed through the SaaS and needs a key. Missing for 10: detailed self-hosting docs (deployment, config, scaling), a clear feature-parity statement between the open-source branch and the hosted service (e.g., proxy pool, VLM/ReaderLM extraction), and independent hands-on corroboration of a self-hosted deployment.
